items.headline: Harbaugh: Chargers 'sloppy' in loss to Cardinals
items.description: The Chargers fell apart Sunday after their opening drive, with coach Jim Harbaugh calling the performance "uncharacteristic."

items.headline: Cardinals defeat Chargers, pull off Week 1's biggest upset
items.description: On Sunday afternoon, Mike LaFleur became the first Cardinals full-time coach to win his debut since Don Coryell did it in 1973, as Arizona authored a 26-14 victory over the heavily favored Los Angeles Chargers at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California.
